plan.problem: The physical guide terminal opens the new destination, then town-interaction-flow.js overwrites destinationViewMode with menu, causing the old work-card list to render instead of the new guide home.
plan.currentContract: changeScene(target) calls openDestination(target), which already selects work_guide for leisure_catalog, but the interaction layer subsequently forces all ordinary non-town targets into menu mode.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The second interaction-layer assignment defeats the destination-specific view-mode decision introduced for the guide, so the new terminal cannot be reached from its real in-town trigger.
plan.design: Exclude leisure_catalog from the generic post-change menu override. Let the already-completed openDestination() render stand for this target while preserving the old override for other normal destinations.
plan.migration: No migration. One conditional in town-interaction-flow.js and one regression assertion are changed.
plan.compatibility: All non-guide interaction paths retain their existing behavior; no guide data, work identity, launch URL, or map trigger changes.
plan.rollback: Revert the implementation commit after the immutable Plan Lock commit to restore the previous interaction condition.
plan.promotionRisk: Production is out of scope. The follow-up must be visually verified on staging before any later promotion.
